clips.title: The story
paras: The Hall of Gears is a multi-tiered industrial chamber situated inside the fallen city of Gnomeregan, just past the Clockwerk Run. Once a bustling center of mechanical movement, it has fallen into ruin, flooded with toxic sludge, roaming oozes, and irradiated troggs.

Positioned just beyond the Clockwerk Run, the Hall of Gears illustrates the catastrophic collapse of the gnome capital. Divided into two main levels, the chamber's upper catwalks are held by aggressive, irradiated troggs that claw through collapsed access shafts. Below, the floor sits drenched in pools of radioactive fallout, where corrosive slimes and living poison elementals thrive in the toxic runoff.
